report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty deployment is established. No bounded cause is substantiated; logs were excluded and are needed.
missing_evidence: Order and gateway logs (excluded from context) to identify any actual error signature or failing route
Error-rate/latency metrics over a wider window and other services to confirm whether checkout errors occurred at all
Deployment history showing a version change preceding any observed error onset
